additional_info.body:
Dear Jan,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided and a deeper system check, we can confirm that the issue is resolved. We have identified that the fault was caused by a software bug.
As shown in the the attached log, each time the system gives a "LEM DC Meter" error, a few moments after it indicated that the "LEM DC Meter" is working:
We will continue to monitor the charger for the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
